## v2.3.3

### Fixed and improved

- Standalone and RNode `.bin` downloads are now complete images, for esptool at 0x0 or bmorcelli's Launcher.
- After a Launcher install, internal storage is prepared automatically, and the device asks before erasing another app's data.
- When internal storage runs low, the oldest messages are removed; an SD card keeps the full history.
- Settings → Storage shows internal usage and whether history is complete on the card or rolling.
- Fixed incoming messages being delayed or failing when the last packet of a link's setup was lost or late.
- Follow your local radio regulations for frequency, transmit power and duty cycle; Settings → LoRa now says so.
